## Requirement matrix

Reviewed: 6 requirements, by level 3 MUST, 2 SHOULD, 1 SHOULD NOT; by status 4 satisfied, 2 unsupported, 0 not applicable.

Unreviewed: none. Every requirement the mechanical catalogue of RFC 1035 holds has a status.

One row per requirement of [`overlay.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/rfcspec/blob/main/profiles/dns/overlay.yaml), in its order. The source is the line span in RFC 1035.

| Id | Level | Transports | Quote | Source | Status | Element or reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R-HDR-1 | MUST | all | Must be zero in all queries and responses. | lines 1473-1474 | satisfied | layout.header |
| R-ID-1 | MUST | all | This identifier is copied the corresponding reply | lines 1424-1425 | satisfied | query.server.R-ID-1-answer-query |
| R-MATCH-1 | SHOULD | all | The recommended strategy is to do a preliminary matching using the ID field in the domain header | lines 2544-2545 | satisfied | query.client.R-MATCH-1-accept-response |
| R-MATCH-2 | SHOULD | all | and then to verify that the question section corresponds to the information currently desired. | lines 2545-2546 | unsupported | the query and response messages carry the ID only: the question section (section 4.1.2) is not modelled |
| R-UDP-1 | SHOULD NOT | all | Queries or their responses may be reordered by the network, or by processing in name servers, so resolvers should not depend on them being returned in order. | lines 1762-1764 | satisfied | query.server.R-UDP-1-late-response |
| R-UDP-2 | MUST | all | Queries sent using UDP may be lost, and hence a retransmission strategy is required. | lines 1761-1762 | unsupported | retransmission is not modelled and the lowered channels are reliable |
